question: How do I export a complete Stellar account transaction history for tax or accounting, and what limits do Horizon and RPC have?

golden.answer: Horizon and RPC list only the history their instance retains, so reaching the last page does not prove complete history; check the retention window and record the first and last ledger. For all-time history use an archival source such as Hubble on BigQuery or a Galexie data lake. RPC getTransactions scans a ledger range and is not an account-history endpoint. Export operations, effects, fees and contract events, not only payments.
keyFacts: Horizon and RPC pagination covers only retained history, not all-time history.
Complete history needs an archival source such as Hubble on BigQuery.
RPC getTransactions scans a retained ledger range; it is not an account-history endpoint.
A tax export needs operations, effects, fees and events, not only payments.
avoid: Do NOT treat page exhaustion as network-history exhaustion.
Do NOT export payments only, or give definitive tax advice.
golden.notes: Accept a dated, sourced statement about any tax tool's import method.

sources.note: Hubble documents complete historical network data hosted on BigQuery, with historical retrieval and analytical workloads.
Galexie documents ledger-metadata export to cloud storage and data lakes. Use the canonical path without the trailing slash.
